Hi Neha / Marcus,

Thanks again for the POC last week — the team is aligned on the model performance and we want to move the procurement/legal steps forward. Attached is our internal evaluation summary and a short wish-list for data residency/audit requirements.

High-level asks:
- Can you share a mutual action plan (MAP) that sequences MSA/DPA/order form sign-off so our legal and procurement teams can align?
- We have one legal question that will affect timeline: does Redwood require the DPA to be fully executed prior to issuing PO?
- Target close window from our side: ideally completed by mid-August. Is that feasible?

Attachments: Eval_Summary_July2026.csv

Thanks,
Emily Shaw
Director, IT Procurement
PharmaPlus Biotherapeutics

Subject: Re: Procurement sequencing & MAP request — PharmaPlus POC

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear summary and the evaluation CSV. I spoke with Marcus and we drafted a mutual action plan and a proposed sequencing for legal/procurement.

Summary (high level):
- Week 0 (today): Redwood sends MAP + initial MSA/DPA redline guidance (attached).
- Week 1: PharmaPlus security questionnaire + quick tech deep-dive (we'll join live); legal to send any MSA redlines.
- Week 2: Redwood returns negotiated redlines; DPA reviewed in parallel; PO request submitted once redlines are agreed in principle.
- Week 3: Signatures (DocuSign) and order form processing; provisioning + kickoff.

Key dependency: We typically require an executed DPA prior to transferring any production data, but order form PO issuance can sometimes be done in parallel if legal is comfortable with a conditional PO tied to DPA completion. Laura (legal) is looped to confirm.

I attached: PharmaPlus_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v3.xlsx (workback schedule) and a short MSA summary with known clauses we expect to touch (MSA_redlines_Pharmaplus_20260731.pdf).

Next steps: Laura will confirm our recommended sequencing and turnaround times. Marcus will confirm procurement touchpoints and whether a vendor packet is needed for your AP.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min call if you'd prefer to walk the timeline together.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

- PharmaPlus AP will need our W9 + vendor packet and estimated monthly billing cadence to open a PO. I can send the vendor packet template today.

Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement sequencing & MAP request — PharmaPlus POC

Hi all — I reviewed the MSA draft and the MAP. Key legal notes and recommended sequencing below.

MSA redlines (high level):
- Data residency & retention: request clarifications on backup snapshots, audit log retention windows, and KMS scope.
- DPA: we recommend executing the DPA concurrently with the MSA. DPA contains the gating language for data transfer.
- Liability/cap: suggest alternate cap language for enterprise procurement; will propose specific language in redline.

Recommended sequencing (legal):
1) Execute MSA + DPA together (preferred).
2) If procurement needs to issue PO earlier for internal cycles, we can accept a conditional PO tied to DPA execution within X business days, but redlines must be agreed in principle.
3) Order form (pricing & usage terms) can be finalized and attached to the MSA as an order form exhibit and routed for signature after MSA/DPA signatures.

Estimated turnaround: I can provide annotated redlines to Emily by EOD Thu, Aug 6 (3 business days). If we need faster, I can prioritize but would need confirmation on corner-case clauses (indemnity, export controls).

Bottom line: executing MSA+DPA together reduces downstream friction. If PharmaPlus must run AP earlier, we'll accept a conditional PO with a clear acceptance window.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
---
(Referenced attachments: MSA_redlines_Pharmaplus_20260731.pdf)

Thanks Laura — that sequencing makes sense and aligns with our internal risk posture. A few quick confirmations from our side:
- PharmaPlus prefers MSA+DPA executed together. We can issue a conditional PO this week if Laura's redlines are agreed in principle.
- Acceptance criteria for evaluation: the attached Eval_Summary reflects the key metrics — we will confirm in writing but latency and token cost are primary.
- Target close: aiming for signatures by week of Aug 10–14, ideally Aug 12 if possible.

Please route a DocuSign powerform or the signed MSA/DPA when ready. I'll share internal AP contact details and the vendor packet after we confirm final sequencing.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to set a 20-minute sync Thurs if needed.

Best,
Emily Shaw
Director, IT Procurement
PharmaPlus Biotherapeutics
